messages:
emma: FYI flagged: upstream advisory for libssl/glibc affecting Ubuntu 22.04 base images. need to triage impact and a short mitigation path.
sec-bot: Automated scan found: registry.redwood.co/base/ubuntu:22.04 -> libssl (CVE-2026-2101), glibc (CVE-2026-2102). severity: HIGH. link: https://sec.redwood.co/alerts/1918765432
sai: which services are using the affected tags right now? can we list by image digest?
emma: quick inventory: inference-runtime (gpu-workers) -> ubuntu-22.04@sha256:aaa111, api-gateway -> ubuntu-22.04@sha256:bbb222, buildkite-agent -> ubuntu-22.04@sha256:ccc333. high risk: gpu-workers (public-facing models + KMS access).
kevin: priority = gpu-workers (prod) > api-gateway (prod) > buildkite (non-prod). suggested short-term: rebuild minimal images with patched packages and sign, then promote to staging. plan for full rebuild of all derived images within 72h.
olivia: signing question: do we have a cosign key in KMS for CI to sign images? HSM/KMS rotation needed? also need audit trail for promotions.
marco: agree on RBAC changes: only image-promote role should be allowed to push "prod" tags. current setup lets platform-engineers promote; we should gate via a new IAM role + approval flow in the console. also require an audit_reason field on promotions.
kevin: short-term workaround if rebuild+promote will take too long: apply distro-level hotpatch where possible and restart services. but that is brittle for glibc. prefer image refresh.
sai: CI changes: I'll add a job that 1) upgrades packages, 2) runs smoke tests, 3) generates SBOM + signs with cosign. snippet for the upgrade step:```dockerfile
FROM ubuntu:22.04
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --only-upgrade libssl3 libc6 \
  && apt-get clean && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
```

sai: SBOM generation will use syft and then upload to our SBOM bucket.
emma: timeline proposal: start rebuilds immediately for gpu-workers (team: kevin + sai). target staging promotion in 4h, prod promotion after 2h of staging soak. fallback plan: route traffic to standby pool if promoting fails.
marco: RBAC action: I will open a permission RFC and a short-lived policy to block manual promotions until the new role is applied. we should also require that promotions include the SBOM link and cosign signature in metadata.
olivia: KMS: we have a cosign key in GCP KMS but HSM rotation for enterprise customers needs manual steps. for now use gcp-kms key: gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/cosign/cryptoKeys/cosign-key. cosign command:```bash
cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/cosign/cryptoKeys/cosign-key registry.redwood.co/base:ubuntu-22.04-patched
```

kevin: add to checklist: update node image node pool autoscaler hold so we can roll nodes without triggering scale-to-zero. also ensure KMS permissions are limited to the CI service account.
sec-bot: Follow-up scan queued for patched images. ETA ~30m.
emma: action items: kevin -> rebuild gpu-worker images and push signed tags; sai -> update CI pipeline + SBOM upload; marco -> temp RBAC block + RFC; olivia -> verify cosign/KMS permissions; I'll coordinate deployment windows. target: staged by +4h, prod +6h. :white_check_mark:
marco: noted. I'll also add an audit webhook to push promotion events to workspace #audit-log so SOC gets visibility.
emma: thanks all. post status updates here. if anything blocks, ping me @emma. :eyes:
